artifact.canonical_name: SmoothAgent: Efficient Long-Horizon LLM-Based Agent Serving with Lookahead Context Engineering

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00151v1
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors propose SmoothAgent to execute context transformations ahead of time so long-horizon agent serving can preserve low TTFT.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify lookahead mechanism and measured TTFT/latency effects
targets.finding: SmoothAgent identifies KV-cache invalidation and re-prefill as context-transformation overhead, then uses asynchronous lookahead transformations and a lookahead-aware scheduler; the authors report up to 11.9x TTFT reduction.
